storyName: Two Ends of a Dead Knot
storyInfo: Crownslayer enters Katorga through the mobility layer and obtains communications equipment from Sonya. A mysterious individual sends a coded message to Crownslayer. Gummy deciphers the message and finds out that it was sent by her father. Sonya resolves to launch the final assault.

attributes.content: If you want to come with me, you do exactly as I say throughout the whole thing.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Do you understand?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Yes! Hehe...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: What are you laughing at?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: It's just, you're so dependable, Lyudmila.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Don't say things you can't take back.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: When did you two become such good friends? I guess I never should've worried that you wouldn't get along.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: She's different. We met each other in the Rhodes Island canteen.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Oh, is that why? At the canteen—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Ah! So you're the red-haired lady who makes great Ursine and Siracusan food!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Back on topic. My Arts can conceal my movements. I'll go and find Zima first; it won't be hard if Rosa's coordinates are accurate.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Rosa reports that the situation in the quarantine zone is in flux. It's possible that Zima's base of operations may have moved. Go ahead and check it out, but come back if things don't work out.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Mm-hm.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Why can't we go together?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Pavlovich's people control the mobility layer passages since the lockdown. We'll alert them if we go on together. You have to wait here.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: This area is outside Katorga Raion, and all the workers know me. If anyone comes over, just tell them you're with Lyudmila Ilyinichna.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Understood, but it's best not to be detected. We'll stay hidden and wait for your signal.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: When you see Zima, see if she's hurt, if she's gotten thinner—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I'll do my best.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: No patrols? That's different from the reports.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Sonya's camp should be just ahead.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...If you don't want me to talk to Matvey, I won't. You want to be by yourself, I won't bother you.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: But holler if you need someone to talk to, okay?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I'm here for you. Don't put everything on your own shoulders.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: What the...?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Rosalind—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Don't yell. It's me.
Huh?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You told me to find you if I ever needed help, didn't you?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: So I came.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The comms equipment looks good.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: So you've dealt with the thugs from within the wall, and you're preparing to leave.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: No wonder I didn't see a soul on my way here.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The thugs on the ground might be done for, but the ones on the walls are still up there. We have a tough fight ahead of us.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Are you ready for it?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: We have to think we are. I don't have time or energy to ask every one of them what they think, but the fact that they haven't stopped training is enough.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm not questioning any of you. Based on what I know from the outside, it's a miracle that you're alive at all, much less united and fighting.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: What are they saying out there?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: That it's His Majesty Pavlovich's little kingdom, and he alone decides what lives and what dies within.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The nobles don't care anymore. After all, this plate is going be discarded like cutting away a piece of rotten flesh, along with everyone on it.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Hmph.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: That's how Ursus is, how it always has been... yet those who are abandoned end up struggling to survive.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Amiya didn't want us to have too much contact with you. I never knew you were so sentimental.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It's not about sentimentality...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Let me put it another way. On my way here, I saw someone huddled by a campfire crying, being comforted by someone who was smiling. Their arms were bandaged, and they were as dirty as the snow on the ground.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Some were chatting, some were holding steaming cups of water, some were roasting things over the fire.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: They've been through so many things in a place like this, yet they didn't look like they're in pain. Really, they looked like they were looking forward to tomorrow.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: They had nothing but the hope in their hearts. I've seen this scene before, the same expressions on faces before, in...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Thanks for sharing.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: But we're really short on supplies. Every day might be our last. This cup of tea here could be too. If you don't want it, I do.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Crownslayer says nothing, but gestures for her counterpart to go ahead.
The plainly exhausted young woman does not demur. She lifts the steel cup and downs its contents, tea that has been brewed so many times it hardly has any color left.
...I've told you all the important parts. Anything you want to know before you leave?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Is there anything I can help with before I go?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Well... maybe it's a dumb question.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: But do you think maybe you could use your Arts to get these students out the way you came in?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The mobility layer passage is very narrow. We could maybe get a few dozen out in a night, but you have hundreds... Besides, There is only one way to the passage.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: They are bound to notice your move of this size. If the students get caught out in the open, even with my Arts, we won't stand a chance once those thugs start raining fire down on us—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Forget I said anything. Should've known it wasn't so simple.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Other than that, is there anything I can do?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I thought you were going to ask me if I wanted to escape with you.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Didn't bother. You're not leaving.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Damn straight.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Actually, there IS something you can do. You said you came in through the mobility layer. I take it you're familiar with what's down there...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Talk about bad luck?
I guess you're in here by accident. You don't look like the kind of man who would associate with the elements here.
Ah... yes, you're right. This was quite an absurd accident.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: What are you doing?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Just memorializing fallen friends.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm sorry. You look sad. I hope I'm not interrupting you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Oh, it's perfectly alright. I'm used to being interrupted.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Be my guest, sit down by the fire and get some warmth. There are roasted potatoes, if you're hungry... what's your name?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: My name is Lyudmila... but my friends call me Crownslayer.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...That's a cool nickname.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Have you... slain any particularly important crowns?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Sadly, not yet. But I've seen many tyrants, or should I say, leaders.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The first was in Ursus. She was a remarkable woman, one of the most remarkable I've ever met. She was powerful, and a charismatic leader.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: But her ideals were too distant, and her methods too idealistic. That's why she failed. Maybe it's not quite fair to call her a tyrant. She was just one of the many who fell by the wayside.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The second was in Siracusa. She wasn't even a leader when I first met her. She was a good person, and an unlucky one.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: She became a leader after a strange twist of fate, and tasted power before she realized the importance of responsibility. I was worried she would go astray, but we're destined to go our separate ways.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You've seen a lot. I envy you. I've never even left Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: As for the third, I've only ever heard his name and deeds.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I've never seen him with my own eyes—until now.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Who sent you? You don't look like one of Witte's.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Don't bother guessing. I'm not after you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: What an experience it is, to come back to Ursus after all this while, only to experience something as crazy as this. I guess the State Council's freaking out right about now, trying to get you out without causing a scene.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Perhaps. Or perhaps someone wants me to die in here quietly.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I don't know. I don't think it really makes a difference whether I'm here or in the palace.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The commoners hate you, the nobility looks down on you. How do you even manage that?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: When you try to change something, the people whose cake gets moved do all they can to oppose you. People take turns opposing all the different decisions you make.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Never mind... you wouldn't understand.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I wouldn't. You sound like you think you're doing your best to govern your country. How did Ursus end up like this, then?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You said you've never left Grypherburg? You should. Go out there, and see what this empire of yours really looks like under your rule.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: That's enough!!!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I don't need your ridicule... don't think I don't know what's wrong with the empire. I want to change it too.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You don't know how hard I've tried. No one does. But what can I do, if no one ever truly supports me?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: So what? Are you saying it's everybody else's fault, and you're just a sweet, innocent little tsar?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You want your suffering people to empathize with how hard things are for you, when you don't even understand your own responsibility?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Fine. You're right, I'm a terrible tsar. What are you waiting for, then?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Kill me already. Fulfill the wishes of the nobles who want me dead, and make the commoners who hate me happy.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Then you'll no longer be a little girl who gave herself a stupid khuyovy nickname, but a true crownslayer at last.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Snap out of it, svolotsch!
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Killing you would be easy, but what would that achieve? You think Fyodor matters? Not even a little bit, I tell you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Every kid in Ursus has heard the story of how the tsar put down the Great Rebellion at the age of ten. Do you think they know what kind of mudak sits on the throne?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Do you think your deeds bring glory to the name Fyodor? You don't understand your own responsibility, yet you're complaining as though everything under the sun is doing you an injustice.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You're simply a kid who never grew up, living a lie that all the people around you keep spinning for you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Yebat—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Are you really mourning the people you saw die? Tragedies like these and much worse happen every day in Ursus. Do you really mourn them?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: If you really want to save people, go back to where you should be, find a few decrees that do the right thing, and put your signature and stamp on them.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Is it so hard? The question is, do you really want to do it? Do you know what the right thing is?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I regret inviting you to my campfire.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I don't like to be vulgar, but there are always people who want to make me angry.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Thank you for the invitation, Your Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I pray your generosity will reach further.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Where are you going?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: None of your business.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Don't worry, you want to keep indulging in your little game here, that's your choice. I won't tell anyone.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: There's just one thing I'll say...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: If you were really trying so hard to bring about change, then the palace wouldn't be the only place that's still lit at night, while the rest of Ursus put together doesn't have enough candles to illuminate Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: As Crownslayer departs, a gust of wind extinguishes what is left of the campfire before Fyodor.
Darkness falls, leaving the silent tsar and the wanderer in the cold night.
I know you're there. Show yourself.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: ...Why am I not surprised that you followed me here?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your will and that of Chairman Witte was to avoid any further disturbances arising from your disappearance.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: We therefore had to remain hidden.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: And? What's Witte planning to do with Katorga?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: That is not for us to know.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: If you wish to speak to him, you should return to the palace with us immediately.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: You want to bring me back, quietly put me in a car, then put me back on that chair.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm telling you, no.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You should understand your own situation.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: You are too young, and too willful, compared to the old tsar.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: Idi na hui! Do not compare me with a man who's been dead for ages! Get out of my sight!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm not leaving. I have things to do. I am not a mannequin for Ursus to display in the shop window.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Tell Witte that if he wants me to leave here, he can come pick me up himself.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: They're gone...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Over here!
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: You ran into workers on patrol?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: If 'workers' are people dressed like policemen and carrying machetes and sticks, then yes.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: You ran into Pavlovich's people? But this isn't Katorga, they shouldn't—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: It was a few guys in worker garb that helped us hide. But they left in a hurry, and I didn't get any information from them.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: What about Zima? Did you see her? Is she and Leto alright?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Zima, Leto and the students they gathered are planning to leave the quarantine zone, maybe in the next couple of days.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Leave? Did that Pavlovich let them go?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Not the kind of leaving where you just open the door and walk out.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: What are they planning? Can we help?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I asked the same question. Anyway, I'll talk to the workers on duty in the mobility layer tonight.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: First, I need to try the comms equipment that Zima gave me, or those unemployed workers will soon lose electricity and heat.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Where do we try?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I don't have a safehouse in this area. We need to find somewhere more remote.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: This will do.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The gear's heavy. I'll hold it; you take the headset.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Thanks.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: What about me? Is there anything I can do?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Keep watch. Tell us if there's any movement.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Alright!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: First try.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Can you hear me?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Hello?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: (Whisper) I think I got through, but there's no sound on the other side.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Hello? Can you hear me?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: No sound. I don't think it's the signal.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Not a particularly unusual occurrence. We may have to try again later.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: How long do we have to wait? Can we...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Can we go and find Zima first? Or maybe those workers you were talking about?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I just feel like we should do something. I want to help, if we can help.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Can we reach them from somewhere else?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: There's a comms blackout in Katorga. This equipment will probably be useless in there.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: It's dangerous to go into a direct confrontation unprepared, even if it's a localized conflict within the quarantine zone.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Rosa's report mentioned that some nobles provided military supplies to Pavlovich. Zima's group may be facing military-grade firepower.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I'm not afraid.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Gummy?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I'm not afraid! I want to stand with Zima and Leto—at least stop some bad guys, or crossbow bolts from the shadows!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I want to help them.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Even if it means you'll hurt other people?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: ...If I have to...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: You hesitated. You're not a soldier, Gummy, and neither are Zima or the rest of her comrades. I would rather you not have to face conflicts like this, if that's an option.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Everyone has their own battlefields. No one's is more or less important than any other's.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: What if I told you that a lot of lives depend on what I'm doing right now, Gummy? How would you choose?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Crownslayer, there's no need to—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: If we leave and try to get into the quarantine zone, and fail to get electricity to the people of Grypherburg in time—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Countless people will freeze to death in places like Odoyev, within a week.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: If you stay here without helping Zima and Leto, they might get hit by a bolt, by a shell fragment... they might be in danger, one way or another.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: How would you choose?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: There's no need to be so cruel, Crownslayer!
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Cruel? You think this is cruel?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Do you think you're doing a favor to her by hiding from her what she needs to know? Do you think you're taking responsibility by taking away her choice?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Isn't that arrogance really cruel to those who are left behind?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Hey...
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Which would you choose, Gummy?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: —Why not all of them?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Uh—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I'll help you now, once you are done here, I'm off to help Zima!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Fine.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Barge...
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: Wait, I hear a voice.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: The weak, faint voice from the headset grows clearer.
It is a gentle, hesitant male voice, one that Crownslayer has never heard before.
...Snow Maiden, Great Fin...
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: I've never heard this voice before. He's not my contact.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: He doesn't even seem to be forming a coherent sentence.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: What is he saying?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Sounds like a bunch of unconnected words. It's weird.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: 'White Night.'
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: 'Ice Queen.'
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.text: White Night, Ice Queen, Dreamer, Land, Monster, Chervontsy, Barge, Snow Maiden, Great Fin.

attributes.content: I know all the words, but what does it mean when they're put together?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Hello? Can you hear me? Can you give me any clearer clues?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Clue...
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: Who?
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: Who is this? Who am I talking to?
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: The voice on the other side suddenly grows louder, and broken noises seep from the headset.
Gummy looks down at the words that Crownslayer wrote, and feels her heart race.
White Night, Ice Queen, Dreamer, Land, Monster, Chervontsy, Barge, Snow Maiden, Great Fin.
She has seen these words before. She screams soundlessly, clutching the corners of her shirt tightly, staring at the scribbled words as though trying to bore a hole in the paper.
Those hands holding a book, those hands stroking her hair, that hand wearing that familiar watch... the scenes flash before her eyes.
Lyudmila—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: She casts her burning gaze toward the bewildered Crownslayer.
Hello? This is supposed to be my communications channel. How did you find it?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Who are you—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Lyudmila!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Huh? What is it?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I want to listen.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: This is all he said. There is nothing else.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I want to listen. Please.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Did you figure something out?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I'll know if I listen.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: ...Go ahead.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Crownslayer removes the headset and gives it to the girl.
Gummy takes it with trembling hands, putting it over her ears carefully.
...Chervontsy, Barge, Snow Maiden, Great Fin.
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: Do you remember that? You remember it?
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: Remember it all! Remember!
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: I'll say it again. White Night, Ice Queen, Dreamer, Land...
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: The voice seems so strange, yet so familiar.
A voice that has become distorted through transmission and loss.
A voice that Lada will never forget.
'How much land does a person need?'
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: I hear Papa's voice on the earphone!
attributes.name: Young Girl

attributes.content: 'Fifty hectares? One thousand? Fourteen thousand?'
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: 'No, none of those.'
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: How many is it, then?
attributes.name: Young Girl

attributes.content: Have patience, my dear Lada.
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: 'Ivan walked a long, long way, and returned to where he began before the sun rose. He used up all his strength, and he cannot get up anymore.'
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: Someone will help him, right? Right?
attributes.name: Young Girl

attributes.content: Of course, little cub. Of course.
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: 'The people, in awe of his perseverance, helped him up, and gave him clean water and soft bread.'
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: 'When he woke up, he saw the path that he walked during the day, and the marks he left.'
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: 'It was a wide, broad land, totalling...'
attributes.name: Gentle Voice

attributes.content: 'The land that Ivan needed his entire life was two meters long, one-and-a-half meters wide, one-and-a-half meters deep.'
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Papa...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: You lied to me.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I opened the book again when I grew up. It said, this is all the land that a person needs their entire life.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: It's the size of a coffin, isn't it?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Who are you? What are you talking about?
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: It's Lada, Papa!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Lada...
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: Lada?
attributes.name: Communicator

attributes.content: It's me! It's me! Where are you? What are you trying to tell us?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Tell me, let me hear your voice again...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: If it's the same channel, and it's your father that we reached this time, then the one before...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Do your parents work for the same institution?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I don't know. I think so...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: We'll get to the bottom of this, someday.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Did he say anything before hanging up? Other than these ten terms?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: It was twelve bits.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: There are two more?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Yes. The other two are 'Sarcophagus' and 'Satellite City'.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: The first ten terms each correspond to a children's book with the words in its title.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: All books that my dad used to read to me.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Somehow, I don't think your father just wants us to find these children's books.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: He explained.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: He said the first ten terms correspond to the first two digits of the ten books' identifier numbers. For the last two terms, we take the first character.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Digits and letters, twenty-two in total, the standard format of Ursine military installation identification codes. As for where it is—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: The answer is obvious.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Sarcophagus, Satellite City.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Dur-nar, Gummy, if you're in a hurry, we can set out for the quarantine zone right now.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Mm... I was thinking about what you said to me.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I don't want to make the others worry, but I want to help. I'll find students I know in the quarantine zone, and do some things in secret.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Good. Crownslayer—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I'll come back and contact the workers who are still fighting underground once I've taken you there.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I'm sure they would love to meet our honorable magistrate.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: *Cough*—*cough*—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Zima?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: ...Instructor?!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: What are you doing here? What about the rest of the SSG? Are they alright?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Of course. It's you we're worried about.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: What's with this smoke?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Pavlovich's men attacked the camp. Set it on fire and left. Said it was revenge for what we did.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Funny, isn't it? I've seen fire after fire here, and they've extinguished the one that burned in my mind all this time, the Chernobog fire.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima, if Chernobog makes you—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: No, instructor, thank you...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Grappling with whether to face my fears when my friends are in danger... that's not like me. I'm used to getting my body to move first.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Besides, I have more than just my fists.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You mean—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: 'Unity.'
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I used to think about nothing but leading the charge. But now... now that I know those guys are behind me, I know that we're all headed towards the same goal... I'm confident we can do anything.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: What are you planning to do?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: If he's resorting to burning stuff, that means Pavlovich has lost his heavy weapons.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: They think they're spreading fear. In fact, they're exposing their own weakness... it's an opportunity.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We'll settle the score with Pavlovich, morning of the day after tomorrow.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I need your help, instructor.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sure, but I thought Leto was with you? I don't see her anywhere.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: After the attack, I sent her to warn our allies, and talk about coordinating our attack.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: That is, if he still thinks we're allies...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I saw Matvey, standing alone before the burning house.
It was a lot smaller than I remembered, against the backdrop of towering factories. Even the fire was dwarfed by the burning workshops.
He looked up at the smoke above the fire that wouldn't go away, the broken beams, and the scattered pages. His face was as calm and impassive as it had always been.
But it was his house, which he built plank by plank, nail by nail... it was the headquarters of the Unbound. It was our home.
Who? Who did this?!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Matvey... they—
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Blyat! Mudak!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Ah, Ukusik.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: There was no other expression on his impassive face. Or maybe my tears just blurred my vision.
Matvey sighed and knelt down to wipe my tears. There was blood all over half his face, but I couldn't see a wound.
'Don't cry over spilt cystymilk.' Remember?
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: But cystymilk's expensive! I've only ever drank it once during New Year's!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: It won't stay expensive forever.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Antosha, if there's anything you need...
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: No. We have some reserves, and we've shared the loot with you.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: We can't stay on the defensive, staying in camp like this... Sonya wants me to tell you that we're planning to attack at dawn, the day after tomorrow.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Our target is the wall.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Tell Sonya, there's no way the Unbound won't show up to strike Pavlovich.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: We will hit his command headquarters. We have been planning this for a long time.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I'll have to talk it over with Sonya.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: You can talk all you want. I don't answer to her. That's my decision.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: But you can trust me on this...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: We will not disappoint those who fight by our side.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: The Imperial Guard's direct command battalion has been deployed to the outskirts of the quarantine zone. Do we set out now to welcome His Imperial Majesty back?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: No. Wait a while longer.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: But the Royal Guard reports that the situation in the quarantine zone will only get more chaotic—
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: All the more reason for us to use this opportunity to fully expose the plans of certain onlookers. Before His Imperial Majesty's precise whereabouts are announced, before we bring him back to the palace safe and sound...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Both the traitors who attempt to harm His Majesty after learning the truth, and the opportunists who choose to parley with the rebels because of the tsar's disappearance, will be stepping up their plans.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We must catch them all.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What if some of them come to their senses?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Then let us hope we will see their anxious or excited familiar faces in the procession welcoming His Imperial Majesty's return.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: He has given them plenty of opportunities with those days of bargaining and probing.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It seems the malaise of Ursus runs deep.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Yes, Vasha, it does. We must hope that we are not too late to cut its tumors.
attributes.name: Witte
